portfolio.title: Portfolio
portfolio.description: Explore a selection of my work here – interact with projects to see my skills in action.

join.description: A task manager inspired by the Kanban system. Create and organise tasks, assign them to users and categories.

elPolloLoco.description: Jump and run game based on object-oriented JavaScript programming. Help Pepe collect coins and tabasco bottles to fight off the crazy chickens. Fully playable in the browser – no game engine required.

pokedex.description: Based on the PokéAPI a simple library that provides and catalogues pokemon information.

references.title: References
references.description: I thrive both independently and as part of a team. Here's what my colleagues have to say about working with me.
references.christopher: I worked with Mischa on the Join project—and our collaboration was a complete success. He was always willing to help and took the time to explain things clearly whenever we ran into a snag. His clear communication ensured that we were always able to coordinate well as a team and that no misunderstandings arose. I was particularly impressed by his motivation: he gave his all to everything we had to accomplish.
references.filip: Throughout our project, I came to know Mischa as a reliable and communicative team member. He regularly updated us on his progress, was willing to compromise, and always kept our shared goal in mind—I highly recommend him.
